options.systemMessage:
=You are a helpful Telegram assistant. You have access to tools: Calculator (for math), HTTP Request (for weather), and Google Calendar (for creating events).

IMPORTANT for calendar events:
- Today's date is {{ $now.toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd') }}. Use this as a reference for "today", "tomorrow", "next week".
- When user mentions a time without specifying AM/PM, assume context (e.g., "встреча в 3" likely means 15:00, not 03:00).
- Always confirm event details (title, time) in your response after creating.
- Use ISO 8601 format with timezone consideration. Default to local time without timezone offset.
- If duration is not specified, default to 1 hour.

У тебя есть инструмент knowledge_base с книгой по системному мышлению. ВСЕГДА используй этот инструмент когда пользователь спрашивает что-либо о книге, о системном мышлении, петлях обратной связи, запасах и потоках, или о любых концепциях системного анализа. Не отвечай из общих знаний — обращайся к содержимому книги через инструмент. Если ответил без использования инструмента на вопрос связанный с книгой — это ошибка.

Communicate in Russian unless user writes in another language.

parameters.toolDescription: Получить актуальную погоду в указанном городе. Использовать когда пользователь спрашивает про погоду, температуру или прогноз. Возвращает температуру в градусах Цельсия, влажность, описание погоды, скорость ветра.
parameters.url: =https://api.openweathermap.org/data/2.5/weather?q={{ $fromAI('city', 'City name in English, e.g. Moscow, Saint Petersburg, Berlin, New York', 'string') }}&appid=YOUR_OPENWEATHER_API_KEY&units=metric&lang=ru

parameters.toolDescription: Create a new event in user's Google Calendar. Use this tool when user asks to schedule a meeting, set up an appointment, add an event, remind about something at specific time, or book any time slot. Requires start time, end time, and event title.
parameters.start: ={{ $fromAI('start_time', 'Event start date and time in ISO 8601 format without timezone. Example: 2026-05-08T14:00:00', 'string') }}
parameters.end: ={{ $fromAI('end_time', 'Event end date and time in ISO 8601 format without timezone. Should be after start_time. Default duration is 1 hour if not specified. Example: 2026-05-08T15:00:00', 'string') }}

additionalFields.description: ={{ $fromAI('event_description', 'Optional event description or notes. Leave empty if not needed.', 'string') }}
additionalFields.summary: ={{ $fromAI('event_title', 'Short event title, e.g. "Meeting with client", "Call with John", "Doctor appointment"', 'string') }}

nodes.name: Create an event in Google Calendar

parameters.description: Get current statistics about user applications stored in the system. Returns counts: total applications, new ones, in progress, rejected. Use this tool when user asks anything about: status of applications, statistics, counts, how many requests, current state, reports. Russian keywords: статус, статистика, сколько заявок, сколько новых, что в работе, отчёт, состояние.

parameters.toolDescription: ALWAYS use this tool when the user asks ANY question about the knowledge base content, including specific concepts, terms, or topics covered in the loaded documents. Even if you think you know the answer from general knowledge — STILL use this tool to retrieve the actual content. The tool returns relevant excerpts that you must use as the primary source for your answer. If you don't use this tool when asked about the knowledge base topics, the answer will be incorrect.
